items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 2 at 3:55PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
A storm moving in from the Bering Sea will bring widespread,
prolonged rainfall for Southwest Alaska through Tuesday.

- Rain amounts: Through Tuesday afternoon, widespread rainfall
amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected across most of Southwest
Alaska, with locally higher amounts (up to 2.5 inches possible)
in the Togiak area, along the Kuskokwim Valley, and near the western
Alaska Range.

items.description:
As a coastal system moves across Western Alaska Sunday into
Monday, it will bring widespread moderate to heavy rain well
inland. Rain totals from Sunday night through early Tuesday

erosion. Secure and move items away from beaches.
